_about: The source turbo pump's load guard (src/core/turbo_guard.py; docs/how-it-works/turbo-guard.md). It warns when the turbo works harder than normal at full speed - as when the valve to its backing pump was closed on 26 October 2026 - and, if its current doesn't fall back, shuts the source down while it still has hours in hand. The turbo itself is never stopped. Times in seconds.
_normal: The readings at full speed with the backing line open (26 October 2026, overnight: 0.7-0.8 A, bearing 43 degC, converter 28 degC). Set them again if the pump or its cooling changes.
_margins: An overload: the current this far above normal. Running hot (a warning only): the bearing or converter this far above normal.
_stages: WARNING after warn_after_s of an overload; CRITICAL critical_after_s after that; the source shut down trip_after_s after the warning (or pump_warning_trip_s after the pump's own warning, if sooner) unless the current's excess has fallen by falling_fraction from its peak in the last falling_window_s. The alarms clear after clear_after_s back to normal.
_judging: Only at full speed (at_speed_pct of its maximum) for settle_s - a run-up draws more - on readings smoothed over smooth_s (a gas burst lasts seconds).
